title: The Long Memory of the Efficient Market
supported_mechanism_claims: Persistent trade/order signs need not imply predictable returns because liquidity can adapt.
Observations in other equity markets motivate, but do not validate, BTCUSDT signed-flow hypotheses.
scope_note: Historic public research only; no fitted coefficients or crypto profitability are transferred.

title: Hawkes Processes in Finance
supported_mechanism_claims: Self-exciting point-process models are a coherent mechanism lens for event-time clustering.
Estimating actual event-time excitation requires individual timestamped events, not bucket counts alone.
scope_note: Cites the point-process framework only; no fitted Hawkes model, parameter or project event outcome.

title: Flow Toxicity and Liquidity in a High-frequency World
supported_mechanism_claims: Trade-flow imbalance and activity can motivate an adverse-selection interpretation subject to adequate trade-side classification.
A toxicity score is not a tradable profit claim and must not be treated as a validated BTCUSDT strategy.
scope_note: No VPIN implementation or score is adopted; BTCUSDT outcomes are entirely unexamined.
